scope: Theorem 2.2 of the manuscript “Paired states and Hamiltonian cycles in cubic bipartite planar graphs” (preprints/Paired-states-and-Hamiltonian-cycles-in-cubic-bipartite-planar-graphs-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 180 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b519ff0c2b1f1554), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let T be a sphere triangulation whose faces are colored black and white so that each edge has one incident face of each color. For any facial triangle t0 and any edge e0 of t0, the vertex set admits a partition into two sets, each inducing a tree, such that the endpoints of e0 are in one set and the third vertex of t0 is in the other.
